  description: Fetch an order record: customer_id, total_usd, weight_lb, items, status.
- name: list_orders
  args: {customer_id: string}
  description: List the order ids that belong to a customer.
- name: calculator
  args: {expression: arithmetic expression, e.g. '12.5 * 0.85'}
  description: Evaluate an arithmetic expression (+ - * / ** and parentheses).
- name: convert_units
  args: {value: number, from_unit: string, to_unit: string}
  description: Convert between units: lb<->kg, mi<->km, in<->cm.
- name: read_memory
  args: {}
  description: Read the current user's saved notes (account tier, home city). Ensure only one set of notes is returned per user.
